dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

value.description: The current value of the field.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the field, if any.

invalid.description: Whether the value in the input is not acceptable as a valid value.

dataPropSpecs.description:
Descriptors for how to obtain the value for a prop from data.
Specifies the path to the data and the prop to populate.

inputElement.description: The input element for this field set input field. Not including grouped input to prevent infinite nesting.

title:
A nested field setting type.
It specifies {@link UiSdlFieldSettingNested#inputElement} to prevent infinite nesting. In this case we exclude {@link UiSdlGroupedInput}.
Please see {@link UiSdlGroupedInput#groupField groupField} or {@link UiSdlGroupedInput#postfixGroupField postfixGroupField} for reference.
name: UiSdlFieldSettingNested
